verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs say the developer documentation includes interactive widgets for exploring and testing the Core API directly from the browser, backed by a sandbox environment. The per-resource API reference pages (cards, users, card products) and a sandbox quick start support the explore-and-run workflow. Missing for 10: detail on how the widgets work (request builders, code samples, language snippets), independent or hands-on corroboration that they run as claimed, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404).
